name: pi-openai-stt
description: STT provider for any OpenAI-compatible API gateway. Implements the SttProvider contract from pi-telegram-echo; registers with id 'pi-openai-stt'. Talks POST /v1/audio/transcriptions. Config (first non-empty wins): explicit OpenAiSttArgs.baseUrl/.apiKey > extensions['pi-openai-stt'].base_url/.api_key in telegram.json > OPENAI_STT_BASE_URL/OPENAI_API_KEY env vars > ~/.pi/agent/auth.json (api_key only) > smart default (OpenAI's API if a key is resolvable, else the local fw-openai-sts shim at http://127.0.0.1:8081/v1). Also: OPENAI_STT_MODEL (default whisper-1), PI_TELEGRAM_LANG (default yue).
